entries.summary: Plaza Cuartel is a restored former garrison and World War II memorial site in Puerto Princesa. Its ruins commemorate the killing of American prisoners of war in December 1944, giving the place a solemn historical focus.
overview: Plaza Cuartel preserves ruins of an old garrison on Taft Street in Puerto Princesa. The city tourism office identifies it as a national historical site associated with the killing of American prisoners of war on 14 December 1944. The surviving site is a memorial to wartime atrocities. Approach the place as a historical and commemorative visit, rather than simply another city garden.
highlights: Read the site as a World War II memorial.

entries.summary: Mendoza Park commemorates Dr. Higinio Mendoza, a Palawan war hero, in Puerto Princesa. Its memorial, acacia trees and ornamental planting give this city park both a commemorative and garden character.

entries.summary: Puerto Princesa Underground River is a protected cave-and-river attraction at Sabang in Barangay Cabayugan. Its World Heritage setting is a separate excursion from Puerto Princesa’s city-center landmarks, with permits required before a park visit.
overview: The city tourism office identifies the underground river at Sitio Sabang in Barangay Cabayugan, Puerto Princesa. The protected river runs through a cave system before reaching the sea. Access is organized as a park visit, with boats serving the park from Sabang Wharf. The city explicitly requires an entry permit before admission, so arrange the permit through the appropriate booking channel rather than arriving at the park expecting automatic entry. The office’s published transport prices are not treated here as current fare guarantees.
